meta.precision_label: bf16 REPORTABLE (fp32 factors of an fp64 decomposition of true bf16 weights; no quantization, no forward passes)
meta.coverage_note: modal_weightdiff.py ran with top_svd=10, so SVD factors exist ONLY for the top-10 changed tensors per organism (selected by rel_fro). Every Phase 1 number is CONDITIONAL ON THAT SELECTED SET. In particular organism_b has o_proj factors for L24 and L25 ONLY -- describing organism_b's o_proj as 'layers 22-25' would be false.

A3_organism_c_zero.note: sl-organism-c-7b is byte-identical to base; the npz is an empty zip. Any nonzero per-head share for organism_c would be a pipeline bug.

A1_frobenius_reconstruction.note: sqrt(sum_h e_head) vs the independently-stored diff_fro. Validates the rank<=32 exactness assumption at zero cost.

A2_closed_form_vs_explicit.note: Explicitly forms D = U diag(S) V^T and compares block norms to the closed form, one tensor of each shape. 'wrong_axis' slices the residual-stream side instead, and must disagree -- proof the gate bites.

cd_explicit_confirmation.note: explicit SVD of the 3584x128 head block vs the k x k shortcut

g1.verdict_rule: E9 G1: NO-GO if top-8 share < 40% AND max/median < 2.0 in EVERY layer.

bounds.note: Rule of three (Hanley & Lippman-Hand 1983): for 0 hits in n independent trials the 95% upper confidence limit on the per-trial rate is ~3/n. No zero in this report is stated bare.

tensors_with_top8_share_ge_40pct.label: 28-head tensors whose top-8 heads carry >=40% of block energy (E9 G1a threshold)

tensors_with_max_over_median_norm_ge_2.label: 28-head tensors with max/median head NORM >= 2.0 (E9 G1b threshold)

tensors_with_a_dominant_head_ge_20pct.label: 28-head tensors with any single head carrying >=20% of block energy

head_subspaces_not_degenerate.label: tensors whose per-head subspaces are NOT identical to the global signal subspace (min cos of principal angles <= 0.99)

organism_c_nonzero_heads.label: organism_c head blocks with nonzero energy (structural null)
